_doc: Recorded ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 11 (QASv2 quasi-analytical targets) engine-run results for fluxion's own air-side model (Issue #4274). GENERATED by the §11 engine-run harness (tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/section11_engine_run.rs) — re-record with FLUXION_SECTION11_WRITE_RESULTS; never hand-edit.
_method: Each case × system is dispatched through the engine's PressureDrivenAirLoop public API (specified-flow fan states, OutdoorAirMixer, SplitAirLoopNetwork commanded branch dampers, VavFlowController, the inverse/humidity ZoneAirNode) plus the engine coil components (CoolingCoil, HeatingCoilComponent), in the QAS configuration. No system-level glue is harness code; the binding conventions (curve shut-off head, branch damper resistance, unit humidity-node volume, dry-air mixing fractions, the engine's own cp/density/h_fg conventions) are documented in the harness module docs. The QAS targets are point values, not bands: no band is fitted to the engine output.

_status_legend.known_fail: the engine value is outside the comparison tolerance — recorded with the real engine value, target and gap
_status_legend.not_runnable: the quantity cannot be produced by fluxion's air-side API; the row quotes the API gap
_status_legend.pass: the engine value is inside the declared comparison tolerance
